verdict.rationale: Twilio's documentation describes public REST APIs that can be called directly over HTTPS or through SDKs. These include the Phone Numbers APIs, the Regulatory Compliance REST APIs and the Messaging API, and the API surface spans over 1,800 endpoints that are indexed from public API specifications. Community users independently describe the API as very easy to use. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration that an AI agent actually drives the product end-to-end through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can use the APIs directly over HTTPS or through Twilio SDKs available for several programming languages.
With the Phone Numbers APIs, you can search for and buy available Twilio phone numbers, manage your Twilio numbers, port a phone number you own to Twilio
gives AI coding agents direct, structured access to Twilio's full API surface—over 1,800 endpoints across 30+ products—without leaving your IDE.
The MCP server indexes public API specifications only.
